18. There will be other situations where the judge may decide not to use the trans person’s
preferred name/pronouns to ensure a witness can give best evidence, eg a female rape
victim may find it incomprehensible if the judge and others in court refer to her biologically
male attacker as “she”. In the end, it is for the judge to ensure that a proper balance is struck
between respecting how a trans person, as with any person, wishes to be addressed (within
reason), and enabling a witness to give best evidence/recount events as accurately and
truthfully as possible.
